head_commit_message:
Install Vercel Web Analytics

# Vercel Web Analytics Installation Report

## Summary
Successfully installed and configured Vercel Web Analytics for the Freshmilk Jarvis project.

## Implementation Details

### 1. Package Installation
- Installed `@vercel/analytics@2.0.1` package using npm
- Updated `package.json` to include the new dependency
- Updated `package-lock.json` with the resolved dependencies

### 2. Created Landing Page with Analytics
Since this is an API-only project with serverless functions and no existing frontend, I created a minimal landing page at the root to:
- Provide a user-friendly introduction to the service
- Display available API endpoints and Slack commands
- Integrate Vercel Web Analytics for tracking

**Created File:**
- `public/index.html` - A responsive landing page that includes:
  - Vercel Analytics initialization script (`window.va`)
  - Deferred loading of the analytics script from `/_vercel/insights/script.js`
  - Service description in Korean
  - List of API endpoints (health, slack/commands, github/webhook)
  - List of available Slack commands (/daily, /daily-summary, /record, /ask, /action, /weekly)
  - Modern, professional styling with gradient background

### 3. Configuration Approach
Following the official Vercel Analytics documentation (fetched from https://vercel.com/docs/analytics/quickstart), I used the **Vanilla JavaScript/HTML** approach since this is not a framework-based project:

```html
<script>
  window.va = window.va || function () { (window.vaq = window.vaq || []).push(arguments); };
</script>
<script defer src="/_vercel/insights/script.js"></script>
```

### 4. How It Works
- The `public/` directory is automatically served by Vercel as static files
- The `index.html` will be served at the root URL (/)
- All existing API endpoints remain unchanged and continue to work via the rewrites in `vercel.json`
- Analytics will automatically track page views when users visit the landing page

## Files Modified
1. `package.json` - Added @vercel/analytics dependency
2. `package-lock.json` - Updated with resolved dependencies

## Files Created
1. `public/index.html` - Landing page with analytics integration

## Next Steps for Deployment
1. Deploy to Vercel using `vercel deploy`
2. Enable Web Analytics in the Vercel dashboard:
   - Go to your project settings
   - Navigate to Analytics section
   - Click "Enable" button
3. Once deployed, visit your site to verify the landing page loads correctly
4. Analytics data will start appearing in the Vercel dashboard after users visit the site

## Additional Notes
- The landing page is fully responsive and works on mobile devices
- The page is in Korean (ko) to match the project's documentation and target audience
- No changes were made to any existing API functionality
- The analytics script is loaded with `defer` attribute for optimal performance
- All existing API routes continue to work exactly as before
